headline: As of 2026-10-18: 9,235,707 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 9,235,707 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,399,377), Georgia (857,347), Florida (833,739).
